units.source_text: 过不多天，已是严冬腊月，霰雪纷飞。

en.t: Before many days had passed, deep winter had come, and sleet and snow were flying everywhere.
The Lady of Akashi felt even more lonely.

units.source_text: 她想起此身忧患频仍，异乎常人，不禁悲伤叹息。

en.t: Thinking how troubles had come upon her again and again, in a life unlike that of ordinary people, she could not help grieving and sighing.

units.source_text: 她比平常更加疼爱这小宝贝了。

en.t: She cherished the little treasure even more tenderly than usual.

units.source_text: 有一天大雪竟日，次日早晨，积雪满院。

en.t: One day heavy snow fell from morning until night, and by the next morning the courtyard was filled with drifts.

units.source_text: 她平日难得到檐前闲坐，这一天回思往事，预想将来，

en.t: She seldom had the chance to sit idly by the eaves, but that day, looking back on the past and imagining the future,

units.source_text: 偶尔来到檐前，坐眺池面冰雪。

en.t: she happened to come out beneath the eaves and sat gazing at the ice and snow on the surface of the pond.

units.source_text: 她身上穿着好几层柔软的白色衣衫，对景沉思，姿态娴雅。

en.t: She wore several layers of soft white robes, and as she sank into thought before the scene, her bearing was refined and graceful.
If one looked at her coiled hair and the sight of her from behind,

units.source_text: 无论何等身份高贵的女子，其美貌也不过如此。

en.t: even a woman of the highest rank could hardly surpass such beauty.

units.source_text: 她举起手来揩拭眼泪，叹道：

en.t: She raised her hand to wipe away her tears and sighed,

units.source_text: “今后再逢着这样的日子，更不知何等凄凉也！”

en.t: If I meet another day like this in the years to come, I cannot imagine how desolate it will be.
Then she began to weep in a tender, delicate voice.
After that, she recited a poem.
